title: sign() boundary_from_content: deterministic boundary with collision check is sound
description: sign.rs: boundary_from_content() derives the MIME boundary from SHA-256 of the content. A contributor might replace this with a random boundary to 'be safer'. The current approach is correct: the collision check at the end is the authoritative guard; deriving from content hash gives reproducible output for testing without weakening security. The security note in the function doc explains this. Keep deterministic boundary.
